To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
indomethacin and other inhibitors of prostagladin synthesis inhibit growth and reactivation of human cytomegaloovirus in a human thyroid cell line.
indomethacin and other prostaglandin inhibitors block the growth and reactivation of human cytomegarlovirus in a human thyroid cell line.
indomethacin and related compounds inhibit HCMV growth by inhibiting the early stages of virus growth and by inhibiting reactivation of the latently infected virus.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of inhibitors of prostagladin synthesis on growth and reactivation of HCMV.
the effect of prostaglandins on the growth and reactivation of HCMV.
the role of prostaglandins in the growth of human cytotoxic virus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the inhibitors of prostagladin synthesis inhibit the growth of HCMV in TPC- 1 cultures, and the inhibition of virus growth occurs at the level of the synthesis of virus DNA polymerase.
the synthesis of prostaglandins is required for the growth of HCMV and for reactivation of HCMV from a latent state.
inhibitors of prostagladin synthesis inhibit the growth of HCMV and reactivation of the virus from latency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
indomethacin and other inhibitors of the prostaglandin biosynthetic pathway may be used to control HCMV infections in vivo.
prostaglandin(s) may play a critical role in the regulation of HCMV growth and reactivation from latency.
indomethacin and/or tetracaine inhibited the growth of HCMV by inhibiting the synthesis of early viral proteins.
The main takeaway from our work is that
indomethacin and related compounds may have therapeutic potential for treatment of HCMV infections.
indomethacin and related compounds may be useful for treatment of HCMV infection in patients with immunosuppression.
indomethacin and/or tetracaine may be used to inhibit HCMV replication or prevent reactivation of latent HCMV in TPC- 1 cultures.
